geometry.edge_definition: minimum grid-cell distance from any outer full-frame boundary < edge_width_cells
geometry.active_boundary_mode_source: explicit --active-boundary-mode CLI assertion for this saved artifact
geometry.boundary_interpretation: The audited artifact was evaluated as one full output frame; any visible rectangle follows the external model-frame/padding boundary, not an internal tile, overlap, stitch, or crop boundary.

low_resolution_grid.description: Configured 16x16 low-resolution grid mapped to 128x128 output at 8x in each axis.

patch_mask_and_upsampling_geometry.downscaling_patch_interpretation: The patch size is recorded but not overlaid: predictor regridding, shallow-feature construction, and decoder upsampling prevent a unique direct patch-to-output boundary spacing from config alone.
patch_mask_and_upsampling_geometry.mask_unit_interpretation: Top-level mask_unit_size is defined in current backbone pixels; the configured target/backbone grid and saved output are both 128x128, so 16-cell mask-unit lines are a defensible output-grid overlay.

checkpoint_padding_source_evidence.interpretation: At the checkpoint commit, every detected 3x3 Conv2d definition uses padding=1 and no padding_mode is specified; PyTorch therefore uses its default zero padding.

receptive_field.interpretation: With documented zero padding and radius 94, the farthest output cell is only 63 cells from an outer frame; therefore the padding-independent valid interior is empty.

metric_definitions.residual_correlation: Pearson correlation over paired daily gridpoint corrections
metric_definitions.per_day_spatial_rmse: for each time independently, sqrt(spatial mean((prediction-ground_truth)^2))
metric_definitions.improved_day_fraction: fraction of common days whose corrected spatial RMSE is strictly less than paired-baseline spatial RMSE
metric_definitions.correction_ratio: generated correction magnitude divided by required correction magnitude

corrected.evidence: Paired residual-diffusion inference stores inverse-transformed physical precipitation predictions in mm/day; NetCDF template units are copied from the flux target and are therefore not numeric-unit evidence.

baseline.evidence: Paired residual-diffusion inference stores inverse-transformed physical precipitation predictions in mm/day; NetCDF template units are copied from the flux target and are therefore not numeric-unit evidence.
